releases.name: v0.16.4 — Compact Mission continuation views
releases.body:
# v0.16.4 — Compact Mission evidence in continuation views

## Included changes

- Releases PR #325, already merged into main before this release request. Root and Coordinator compaction checkpoints use the existing evidence-reference projection rather than copying large protected snapshot path arrays into model instructions.
- Native background completion projects its captured result for model context and compaction. It does not substitute today's Mission/run/evidence for the historical result or rewrite the stored background dispatch.
- Retains requirements, unmet work, owner, cumulative budget, next action, original attachment references, measured commands/results and proof identity. The original evidence, snapshot recipe and freshness inputs remain authoritative and unchanged.
- Cold-load accepts large formal snapshot recipes without counting their known path arrays against the existing execution-state size check. Other oversized execution fields retain the existing refusal.

## Existing verification and review

- Source head: `8b4a901739fe53d35b8fb60b7b09a705ee2c2ece`; merge: `68b68a77d08718f07297cc48572833c8f03ed89d`. No open PR remained at the start of this request.
- The author records targeted `continuation`, `native-background` and `operator-mission` tests passing (WSL controller 20.063 s), full suite passing (408.042 s) and Windows tests passing (20.700 s). Reuse those source results; one mandatory full suite is still run on the fixed integrated release candidate.
- The same saved 44,629-path failure replay passed locally in 510 ms without network calls. Root context was 9,112 characters, Coordinator context 9,214 and background model view 11,547, below the reported 1,048,576-character instructions limit. Measured fields and non-evidence packet fields were deep-compared; original hashes and stored background results remained unchanged. The initial cancelled-Mission fixture mismatch and its isolated phase correction are recorded separately in the PR, not erased or treated as a runtime success.
- The author records an independent Reviewer PASS with no Major/Medium finding. PR body, submitted reviews, ordinary comments and inline comments were collected for this release. Automated GitHub review failed due quota without a concrete source finding; keep it pending, not automated Review PASS. No redundant review request or new approval wait.

## Package and verification boundary

The unpublished source candidate used package version 0.16.3, marker `0.16.3-compaction-model-view-v1` and SHA-256 `e497607d72fb40a5c68f7e5fed55381b277b79aee0693507fbf10f9f719bf25f`. It is not the already-published v0.16.3 archive. This release assigns v0.16.4 and marker `0.16.4-compaction-model-view-v1`; do not republish v0.16.3.

Fix one integrated main commit and one archive/SHA-256 before isolated candidate preflight, one mandatory full suite, exact-commit CI and actual native Worker/model startup. Apply, attach and publish that same archive once. Startup confirms execution/model identity, not completed instructions, official benchmark correctness or real-LLM compaction recovery.

Keep explicit user models, unrelated settings and original Mission ledgers. No paid failure replay, new benchmark, original Mission acceptance/resume/cancellation or automatic shared OpenCode restart. Windows candidate disk application and its old loaded-host observation reported in #325 are separate from this Ubuntu release. Shared-host loaded-version/path/hash and real-LLM compaction recovery remain separate observations.

Command/exit/timing, review dispositions, fixed package identity, usage and publication evidence: `_testenv/releases/0.16.4/`.

releases.name: v0.16.3 — Strategy and cancelled Task recovery
releases.body:
# v0.16.3 — Retained-owner strategy and cancelled Task recovery

## Included changes

- Integrates PR #322. Operator compares the original goal, actual result and concrete unmet work when a selected method stalls or unnecessary work is proposed. Concrete alternatives and retained obligations can reach the same ended, quiescent Coordinator through the existing continuation route. A proposal does not admit a new contract, add a reservation, settle work or stop an owner. Planned useful work needs no new approval or logging-only step.
- Integrates PR #323. A Task cancelled before its child's first prompt no longer remains permanently unplannable solely because its saved child is null. Existing native terminal/input/owner/run/call checks and quiescent lineage must establish the exact cancelled calls before planning can continue. Old-generation Task references remain historical comparisons, not renewed admission authority.
- Same-request continuation, unrelated known root children, fresh stop acknowledgements and cancelled-run archiving are covered. Preserve original cancellation/null-child state, prior evidence, nonzero known costs and unknown usage; do not fabricate a terminal, reset budgets or settle twice. Live/unproven owners, pending Review, active tools, freshness, formal validation and final acceptance remain authoritative.

## Existing evidence and review dispositions

- #322's final related command passed (`mission-completion`, `operator-mission`, `mission-direct-execution`): 68.381 s native wall clock / 67.154 s formal evidence interval. The author records an independent Sol/xhigh Reviewer PASS without Major/Medium findings. This is distinct from the unavailable GitHub automated review and is not proof of general strategy improvement.
- #323's final `e55bf52` related command passed: 122 tests and two opt-in Docker skips; native formal interval 64.665 s. Four valid findings were corrected: missing same-request reconciliation, unrelated-child false refusal, stale stop snapshot and missing cancellation archive. Historical failed/partial commands and old-candidate results remain separate; the correcting author's self-check is not independent approval.
- PR bodies, review submissions, ordinary comments and inline comments were collected before integration. GitHub automated code review was unavailable due quota and delivered no concrete code finding; do not treat that failure or CI success as Review PASS or request a redundant review.

## Release boundary and limits

Fix one integrated main commit and one tarball/SHA-256 before isolated candidate preflight, one mandatory full suite, exact-commit Linux/Windows CI and actual native Worker/model startup. Apply and publish that same archive once. Startup confirms execution/model identity, not Mission completion or official correctness scoring.

The reported Windows product failures are not established as the same causal paths. General process expansion, requirement-narrowing fast acceptance and real-model strategic judgement improvement remain unverified/out of scope. No target product or old Mission is replayed, accepted, cancelled, replaced or edited by this release. Standard Ubuntu installation updates do not prove that a separate Windows development artifact or already-running shared host loaded the update; shared OpenCode is not restarted automatically.

Details: [strategy recovery](../mission-strategy-recovery.md), [cancelled admission recovery](../mission-admission-recovery.md). Generated command/exit/timing, review dispositions, fixed package hashes, usage and publication evidence: `_testenv/releases/0.16.3/`.

releases.name: v0.16.2 — Direct validation registration continuity
releases.body:
# v0.16.2 — Direct validation registration continuity

## Included change

- Integrates PR #320. An owning, quiescent direct controller can correct its validation recipe or cwd without replacing the existing Mission/run/unit/admission/reservation or resetting cumulative spend. The immutable contract and historical failed checks remain intact.
- New or changed registrations require actual native checks started after registration. Earlier successful diagnostics are not promoted into formal proof. Source/candidate freshness, other live or unproven writers, current-candidate Review and final acceptance remain authoritative.
- The effective recipe is shared by native capture, finish, Review, recovery and direct-to-Worker handoff. Reuse only the exact passing occurrences of an inherited prefix; do not skip an unexecuted middle check or hide a later native failure.
- V2 handoff guidance uses `executor: "worker"` with `units: ""`; the legacy API omits `units`. `units: []` remains invalid. Handoff continues the same unit and reservation; it is not validation or completion.

## Verification and limits

- Reuses the source PR's recorded final related verification: 238 passed and two Docker skips (63.093 s), plus 48 related goal/ledger/recovery tests (11.250 s). Eight handoff regressions were observed failing before their source-PR corrections and passing afterward. The source author completed native self-recheck, not independent acceptance.
- Existing PR body, review submissions, ordinary comments and inline comments were collected before integration. Automated GitHub code review was unavailable because its quota was exhausted; this is not Review PASS or an actionable code finding. No repeated review request or new approval wait is added.
- The release gate fixes an integrated main commit and one tarball/SHA-256 before candidate preflight, one mandatory full suite, exact-commit Linux/Windows CI and actual native Worker/model startup. Apply and publish that same archive. Startup proves execution/model identity only, not Mission completion or an official benchmark score.
- No Vibe task or original user Mission is resumed, accepted, cancelled, replaced or edited by this release. Previously reported Windows testenv artifacts are distinct from the standard Ubuntu global/config-local installations; updating the latter does not prove those artifacts were updated or loaded.
- Shared OpenCode is not restarted automatically. Installed-byte/asset verification and the shared host's loaded-version verification remain separate.

Recovery details: [direct validation registration recovery](../direct-validation-registration-recovery.md). Generated command/exit/timing, review dispositions, fixed package hashes, usage and publication records: `_testenv/releases/0.16.2/`.

## Release verification

- Commit: `c8a8991d66062f5957212872005cd73666741b15`; PRs #320 and #321.
- Package SHA-256: `9e3d67f537a5320f6fbe0b2b19cd96de717366b97ae03f4b280589469860a164`.
- Linux full: 2497 passed, 4 skipped; 133 files, scheduler valid.
- Windows CI: 55/55 passed on the same commit.

- Known priced startup usage: $0.0576692; 2 unpriced requests remain unknown.
- Automated GitHub code review could not run because its quota was exhausted; no code finding was delivered and no Review PASS is claimed. Existing body/review/normal/inline comments were collected before merge and again before release.

releases.name: v0.16.1 — Nested repository review and conversation recovery
releases.body:
# v0.16.1 — Nested repository review and conversation recovery

- Resolve declared Review outputs against their nested repository or linked worktree before invoking the outer Git. Keep narrow file/directory scopes narrow; unrelated inner sources and Git metadata are not candidate outputs. The Mission root's baseline is not applied to a different repository.
- Keep background settlement inspection errors recoverable without rejecting the next prompt, model context or compaction. Report the failed inspection and next action; retain the native terminal, cumulative accounting and pending reconciliation. Failure is not validation, Review PASS or final acceptance, and does not authorize repeating an already successful external operation.
- Preserve strict errors for broken repositories and missing Git objects. Ordinary tool admission and explicit acceptance checks are unchanged.

## Evidence and limits

- Three new regression cases first failed on the previous implementation: narrow directory/file outputs expanded to an entire ignored worktree, and a settlement error rejected the follow-up prompt. All 140 related Review, background lifecycle and V2 adapter tests passed after correction.
- A read-only replay of the original saved npm-publish Mission/run/scopes reproduced `git ls-files: internal error - directory entry not superset of prefix` on v0.16.0. The corrected inspector returned in approximately 251 ms. Original Mission/run/publication receipt hashes were unchanged; the recorded publish attempt count remained one. This replay made no model request and did not resume or accept the original session.
- The release gate binds one integrated main commit and one tarball/SHA-256 before candidate preflight, mandatory full tests and actual native Worker/model startup. Use that same archive for global/config-local application, GitHub Release and npm publication. Startup does not prove Mission completion or official benchmark correctness. No shared OpenCode service is restarted automatically.

Command/exit/timing, review dispositions, package hashes, startup usage and publication evidence are retained under `_testenv/releases/0.16.1/`. The shared host's loaded version and original session continuation remain separate from installed-byte verification.

## Release verification

- Commit: `eecf5b314f7bcf1371c9e46f7c8d35a8b1559159`; PR #319.
- Package SHA-256: `46dd95db25b4129160b945ef6bb2584781745d4c1a0973e620b5ab650f902524`.
- Linux full: 2480 passed, 4 skipped; 133 files, scheduler valid.
- Windows CI: 55/55 passed on the same commit.
- Native startup: `openai/gpt-6.1-terra#max`, 24648 ms; root `openai/gpt-6.1-sol#xhigh`. Startup only.
- Known priced startup usage: $0.0118484; 2 unpriced requests remain unknown.
- Automated GitHub code review could not run because its quota was exhausted; no code finding was delivered and no Review PASS is claimed. Existing body/review/normal/inline comments were collected before merge and again before release.
- Original Mission read-only replay and public CLI patch migration preserved saved state. No republish of v0.16.0 and no automatic shared-service restart.

# v0.16.0 — Purpose-aligned autonomy

## Scope

- Optional bounded purpose decisions distinguish vision/outcomes from methods. Decisions retain observed outcomes, concrete unmet work and the next useful action across the same Mission's handoff/resume.
- Save observations alongside already-needed planning, submission or Review operations; do not create logging-only work. Fast-lane roots can use their required Review operation without a Coordinator-only submission API.
- Decisions are advisory observations, not execution permission, validation, independent Review or final acceptance. Existing budgets, ownership, evidence freshness and quality controls remain authoritative.

## Observed behavior and limits

- Existing-output reuse reached formal validation, independent Review and acceptance on the original S1 candidate. Two historical refusals remain recorded; that run was not clean.
- The corrected S2 candidate preserved the same root/Mission/requirements/decision across a safe checkpoint and private-server restart, then performed the required real rollback and canonical validation. No generation or stage check was replayed after resume. The required Review operation recorded the decision without an extra logging-only plan or Review.
- S2 repaired a read/write declaration before checkpoint and refreshed one stage check. This is retained as an efficiency limitation, not a clean-run claim. The fixture's low-risk Review skip is distinct from the independent source Review PASS.
- Both historical outer runners exited 1 because of evaluator failures. Original results and failed receipts remain immutable; a separate provenance-bound assessment evaluates collected native outcomes without rerunning model work.
- Known converted CLI cost across these observed roots: $0.792704, with no unpriced requests. This is not total billing. The same local $3 allowance was carried forward; checkpoint/resume usage was counted once.
- These small fixtures do not establish a general success-rate, speed or cost improvement. S1 used a Worker route; S2 used a direct SOL route. Route differences are not attributed to the mechanism.

See [the design and evidence record](../purpose-aligned-autonomy.md) for consultation decisions, candidate identities, failure history and observation references. Final package/preflight/full-test delivery remains a separate release gate; npm publication is manual.


## Fixed delivery

- Commit: `3b05a2ed4738c31f2e710198c243f87b96a5f2b3`. Package SHA-256: `15b400069f1a6b46fd25bd2f7187c065461273d625f196bcc771fb623a4f6d0a`.
- Public CLI migration and retained Mission bytes verified. Final native full suite: 133 files, exit 0; independent Review PASS. Historical outer failures and stale-prefix unit remain recorded separately.
- Same tarball verified in both npm-global prefixes and the OpenCode config-local dependency. Runtime marker/assets: `0.16.0-purpose-aligned-v2`.
- Installed files are new; the existing shared host has not been restarted and new loaded-runtime adoption is not asserted.
- GitHub Release publication is distinct from npm publication. npm publish remains manual and was not executed.
